title: UAAP: Ateneo turns tables on La Salle, secures breakthrough win
summary: Ateneo de Manila University erased a 14-point deficit against rival De La Salle University to secure a 79-66 victory and its first win in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Women’s Basketball Tournament…

blocks.text: Ateneo de Manila University erased a 14-point deficit against rival De La Salle University to secure a 79-66 victory and its first win in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Women’s Basketball Tournament on Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.
